Chapter 1194 - 13: Slash Slash Slash! (Request Subscription)_2

Chapter 1194: Chapter 13: Slash Slash Slash! (Request Subscription)_2

"I can promise that if we seize this first-class treasure land, I can allocate more of the treasure land and the rare wonders it produces to the Galaxy Venerate, but the matter of contesting the treasure land still requires sufficient strength to prove oneself."

The Red Flame Venerable finally looked at the Fierce Sun Ancient Country Emperor: "I hope the emperor prioritizes the interests of the Ancient Country."

"Hmm."

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country Emperor nodded and then looked at Lin Yuan: "Galaxy, what do you think?"

If Lin Yuan hadn’t been confident about his strength just now, the Fierce Sun Ancient Country Emperor would definitely have rejected the Red Flame Venerable with various excuses.

"Then let’s follow the Red Flame Venerable’s suggestion."

Lin Yuan said.

As soon as these words were spoken.

The venerables in the hall couldn’t help but be surprised.

He agreed so easily?

The Red Flame Venerable also gave Lin Yuan an extra glance.

He initially thought the emperor would casually find an excuse to dismiss him.

Unexpectedly, the Galaxy Venerate was so confident.

Although the Galaxy Venerate had prior achievements against the Jihan Venerate and the Beiyin Venerable Sage.

But that was in the Hei Yu Nest, with the Space-Time Teleportation Formation to the capital nearby.

The Galaxy Venerate’s ability to keep those two venerables was not just due to strength but also the deterrence of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s venerables.

If the two venerables had no fears, in a desperate fight, they might not defeat Lin Yuan, but could at least retreat safely.

"I don’t ask for much, just that the Galaxy Venerate can withstand a hundred breaths under the Red Lotus."

The Red Flame Venerable said, Red Lotus Venerable, a seasoned Peak Venerable, withstanding a hundred breaths under Red Lotus Venerable requires at least Peak Venerable strength.

"Alright."

Lin Yuan nodded.

He also wanted to witness the strength of the Fierce Sun Ancient Country’s Peak Venerables, different from the unmatched Great Saints of the Chaos Void, the Peak Venerables’ paths of Chaos Evolution Force have all reached the third level.

"Then the spar between Galaxy and Red Lotus will be set in the capital’s Venerate-level time-space."

The Fierce Sun Ancient Country Emperor said.

The so-called capital’s Venerate-level time-space is a stable time-space developed using the power of the Fierce Sun capital, capable of withstanding Venerate-level battles.

The spar between Peak Venerables, if unrestricted, can ravage an entire great domain, so to minimize the impact, it must take place in the corresponding time-space.

...

In an exceptionally stable ruled time-space.

Suddenly, figures appeared, precisely the Fierce Sun Ancient Country Emperor and the venerable ancient sages.

Lin Yuan and the Red Lotus Venerable stood at the center of time-space, confronting each other from afar.

"Red Lotus Venerable’s Chaos Evolution Force path is the ’Red Lotus Karma Fire’, a terrifying flame almost disregarding most defenses, directly burning on the soul and body."

Information about the Red Lotus Venerable flashed in Lin Yuan’s mind, once on an ancient country battlefield, Red Lotus Venerable single-handedly burned six venerables of the enemy ancient country to nothingness.

Thus establishing his reputation as a Peak Venerable in one stroke.

"Galaxy Venerate." Red Lotus Venerable looked at Lin Yuan from afar, "When it comes to the contest for a first-class treasure land, I won’t hold back."

If it were just a regular spar, Red Lotus Venerable would surely consider the royal face, but now the spar is related to the Venerate quota for the upcoming contest for a first-class treasure land.

Red Lotus Venerable does not want to be dragged down by Lin Yuan in the future contest for a first-class treasure land.

"I won’t hold back either." Lin Yuan also looked serious.

"Good." Red Lotus Venerable nodded, a thought in his mind: "Ignite."

Whoosh.

Red flames resembling lotuses began to burn on Lin Yuan’s physical body, these flames were formless and intangible, utterly unstoppable.

Red Lotus Venerable watched Lin Yuan silently.

With the might of Red Lotus Karma Fire, ordinary venerables wouldn’t last long.

"As long as the Galaxy Venerate concedes, I will immediately withdraw the Red Lotus Karma Fire."

Red Lotus Venerable thought silently, Lin Yuan was not an enemy, he naturally did not intend to seriously injure him.

"Is this the Red Lotus Karma Fire?" Lin Yuan felt his body, soul, and even the internal universe burning under the red lotus flames.

Lin Yuan hadn’t even realized when these flames appeared, the time-space around him hadn’t detected the burning, it just ignited directly on his physical and soul body universe.

Yet...

"Just like being tickled." Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Though the Red Lotus Karma Fire was indeed strange, to burn Lin Yuan’s physical soul body universe to a degree threatening his Origin Source, it would probably take burning for millions of years endlessly.

Lin Yuan’s foundation was incredibly robust, his internal universe measured in trillions of light-years, even allowing the Red Lotus Karma Fire to burn held no threat to his being.

It even burned away the Origin Source slower than it recovered.

"Red Lotus Venerable’s methods are indeed extraordinary." Lin Yuan remarked with slight admiration.

Although its power wasn’t great, this peculiar ability to manifest from nothing surprised Lin Yuan, if it weren’t the Red Lotus Karma Fire but a means that could threaten him, things would truly be troublesome.

"What?"

Red Lotus Venerable was startled to see Lin Yuan appearing completely unaffected by the Red Lotus Karma Fire, instead engaging with him calmly.

Usually, other venerables facing the silently emerging Red Lotus Karma Fire would either drive it away with all their might or begin to retreat, but Lin Yuan just let it burn?

"Galaxy Venerate, unfazed by Red Lotus Karma Fire?"

The venerables watching from afar all displayed changed expressions, even the strongest Red Flame Venerable, Venerable Hengyang, and Venerable Guanglie, found dealing with the peculiar Red Lotus Karma Fire quite troublesome, consuming considerable effort to expel.

But Lin Yuan?

He didn’t care about the Red Lotus Karma Fire’s burning at all.

"How deep is this Galaxy Venerate’s foundation to disregard the Red Lotus Karma Fire?" the Red Flame Venerable pondered.

Originally, he had underestimated Lin Yuan, thinking how could a royal figure at the Venerate level grow without reaching the limit, they still had to be overshadowed by the Peak Venerables like themselves.

"Red Lotus Venerable, it’s my turn."

Lin Yuan smiled slightly, raising his right hand, using time-space as a blade, the power of his internal universe as the source, slashing toward the Red Lotus Venerable.

Lin Yuan’s time-space comprehension had reached the Ninth Realm, among Peak Venerables, such comprehension wasn’t exceptionally outstanding, but the power of his internal universe... indeed exponentially increased the power of Lin Yuan’s strikes by an unknown magnitude.

It’s like having the same sword, identical in material, sharpness.

One wielded with a force of a hundred pounds, the other with a force of a hundred tons.

The difference in power is naturally worlds apart.

Lin Yuan was like that, his profound foundation allowed every strike to have the effect of overpowering skill with sheer strength.

"This?"

Red Lotus Venerable’s pupils contracted, Lin Yuan’s strike cut through layers of time-space, slashing at him.

Swish!

Red Lotus Venerable couldn’t dodge in time, and his right hand was struck by this Time-Space Blade.

Whoosh!

Red Lotus Venerable transformed entirely into blossoming Red Lotus Karma Fires, eventually reforming his figure.

"This strike is not a path of Chaos Evolution Force, yet why is its power so immense?" Red Lotus Venerable couldn’t believe it, it was just a conventional use of the Spatiotemporal Fusion Rule, yet possessed such astonishing power.

"Is it the Heavenly Venerate-level Ancestor’s Bloodline?" Red Lotus Venerable pondered in disbelief, thinking that the bafflingly great power must come from the Galaxy Venerate’s level Ancestor’s Bloodline.

"It’s deflected?"

Lin Yuan looked at the Red Lotus Venerable under the cut, "Surely it won’t be that easy to deal with."

"Fierce Sun..."

In the depths of Lin Yuan’s eyes, a hint of Fierce Sun emerged.

"Slash again."

Lin Yuan activated the Divine Ability ’World’, and in an instant, slashed three hundred and thirty-three blades.

Whoosh.

A total of three hundred and thirty-three Time-Space Blades, entirely composed of the Power of Space-Time, but imbued with majestic power, slashed towards the Red Lotus Venerable.
